# coolify_server (Resource)

Registers an existing machine as a Coolify server over SSH. Coolify connects with the referenced private key and installs its agent; the machine itself must already exist (this resource does not provision VMs). Deleting the resource deregisters the server from Coolify without touching the machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The private key must already exist in Coolify (Keys & Tokens → Private Keys).
resource "coolify_server" "example" {
  name             = "worker-01"
  ip               = "203.0.113.10"
  port             = 22
  user             = "root"
  private_key_uuid = "sk-uuid-from-coolify"
  proxy_type       = "traefik"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) IP address or hostname Coolify uses to SSH into the machine.
- `name` (String) Display name of the server.
- `private_key_uuid` (String) UUID of the Coolify private key used for the SSH connection.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description. Coolify only accepts letters (including Unicode), numbers, whitespace, and `- _ . , ! ? ( ) ' " + = * @ / &` — other punctuation (e.g. a colon or semicolon) is rejected with a 422.
- `instant_validate` (Boolean) Ask Coolify to validate SSH connectivity right after creation. Defaults to `true`. Coolify dispatches this validation as an asynchronous background job — creation itself always succeeds immediately regardless of this flag, and `is_reachable`/`is_usable` will read back `false` right after `apply` even with a good key and IP; they only reflect the real state once the background check finishes, visible on a later `plan`/`refresh`. Set to `false` to skip queuing that background check entirely (e.g. for a server that isn't SSH-reachable yet).
- `is_build_server` (Boolean) Use this server only for building images. Defaults to `false`.
- `port` (Number) SSH port. Defaults to `22`.
- `proxy_type` (String) Reverse proxy to run on the server: `traefik`, `caddy` or `none`.
- `user` (String) SSH user. Defaults to `root`.

### Read-Only

- `is_reachable` (Boolean) Whether Coolify could reach the server on its last check.
- `is_usable` (Boolean) Whether the server is fully validated and usable for deployments.
- `uuid` (String) Server-assigned identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_server.example <uuid>
```
